observations.name: empty-reduction-dispatch
observations.scope: All static exact-type single and finite nonempty heterogeneous tuple logical output values selected by either zero-element guard. Arbitrarily coupled pure whole-state reducers. Empty output has no positions.
observations.residual: Dynamic annotations, precision-changing initializer/accumulator options, graph replacement and effects are outside the declared model. The caller covers both helper branches and contributes no independent proof.

observations.name: same-count-reduction-dispatch
observations.scope: Static equal-count logical outputs over exact scalar types, including coupled whole tuple states. The actual initializer left-identity law is necessary and sufficient for all inputs of a fixed nonempty plan. Empty output is an additional model boundary.
observations.residual: Source assumes initializer identity; nonidentity model witnesses do not refute source-valid reductions. Caller runs zero-element dispatch and eligible singleton tuple normalization first. Layout/bitcast validity, precision-changing reducer signatures, dynamic annotations and graph operations are outside the model.

observations.name: heterogeneous-tuple-projection
observations.scope: Every legal position in an ordered tuple of already evaluated, potentially heterogeneous operands, observing tag and value. Includes arbitrary finite arity and repeated tags.
observations.residual: The retained effect_graph partition, compatibility/status, metadata and graph mutation are outside this theorem.

observations.name: barrier-user-index-remapping
observations.scope: For each legal GTE user, compaction preserves its observed value at the new index equal to the retained-prefix length, using the keep mask for its operand kind.
observations.residual: The source graph transformations, actual metadata updates, scheduling and side-effect behavior are outside this mathematical observation. The two source records share a proof.

observations.name: singleton-tuple-reducer-unpacking
observations.scope: One-result tuple-root reduction. The ordered fold with a singleton state agrees at every coordinate with the scalar body selecting the old tuple root operand. Arbitrary static shape, actual initializer, pure total body and fiber length.
observations.residual: The earlier empty dispatch preempts empty cases. Reducer graph cloning, evaluation effects, dynamic shape flags, metadata and source correspondence are outside the stated value observation. The window rewrite has different geometry.

observations.name: guarded-trivial-sort
observations.scope: All static logical array or heterogeneous tuple values when some extent is zero or the selected sort axis has length at most one. Every bounded row-local selection is covered; every permutation within a fiber is among them.
observations.residual: The interpretation of sort as a fiber-local rearrangement is assumed. Comparator execution, effect order, graph and layout outcomes are separate.

observations.name: signed-pad-unit-interior
observations.scope: The source loop clears precisely the positive gaps on singleton axes and retains signed edges, original output extents and all other gaps.
observations.residual: Static homogeneous pure values, unbounded mathematical arithmetic. Actual dispatch/reachability, mixed precision, overflow, dynamic shapes, layout, metadata, and replacement status are outside the proof.

observations.name: signed-pad-empty-input
observations.scope: Every output position returns the actual fill on a zero-extent input, including nonempty padded output.
observations.residual: Static homogeneous pure values, unbounded mathematical arithmetic. Actual dispatch/reachability, mixed precision, overflow, dynamic shapes, layout, metadata, and replacement status are outside the proof.

observations.name: signed-pad-compatible
observations.scope: With zero edges and equal logical shapes, legal static Pad preserves every tensor value. No all-interiors-zero premise; legal shapes force any remaining holes to be unobservable.
observations.residual: Static homogeneous pure values, unbounded mathematical arithmetic. Actual dispatch/reachability, mixed precision, overflow, dynamic shapes, layout, metadata, and replacement status are outside the proof.

observations.name: signed-pad-negative-edges
observations.scope: Clamping negative edges gives the constructed intermediate shape. Source start/limit/unit-stride bounds are valid and slicing the intermediate Pad recovers the original signed-Pad tensor, including empty output.
observations.residual: Static homogeneous pure values, unbounded mathematical arithmetic. Actual dispatch/reachability, mixed precision, overflow, dynamic shapes, layout, metadata, and replacement status are outside the proof.

observations.name: signed-pad-broadcast-projection
observations.scope: The exact sorted list of padded axes generates the smaller tensor shapes and remapped Broadcast slots. Occupied samples agree and holes give the fill. All mapped axes must appear in the retained list.
observations.residual: Static homogeneous pure values, unbounded mathematical arithmetic. Actual dispatch/reachability, mixed precision, overflow, dynamic shapes, layout, metadata, and replacement status are outside the proof. The proof generalizes coordinate reads to arbitrary maps. The source interpretation relies on ordinary injective broadcast mappings and sorted-subshape deletion; no implementation semantics is inferred for repeated axes.

observations.name: scatterExactCondition
observations.scope: For a single in-bounds modular-word update, either operand orientation preserves the full output vector iff reducer parameter roles differ or the extra addend at the target is zero.
observations.residual: Multiple updates/collisions, floats, other Scatter arms and graph status remain open.

observations.name: gatherSignedBoundary
observations.scope: For positive signed index width w, the full narrowed Select chain agrees with the clamped coordinate on all runtime indices iff extent ≤ 2^(w−1).
observations.residual: Source unrolling requires the configured threshold to admit that extent (default 4); unsigned, other types, layout/effects, backend execution outside this model. Extent zero is a model convention.

observations.name: staticSignedSliceOfPad
observations.scope: Arbitrary-rank legal static Slice of a signed Pad over pure homogeneous values. Inside derives legal shifted bounds; undo reconstructs input data; an outside-axis witness returns fill.
observations.residual: Source branch precedence, runtime extents, conversion, replacement status, layout, machine overflow and graph effects remain outside the three observations.

observations.name: staticSliceAxisShapeBoundary
observations.scope: At arbitrary static rank, preserving the declared shape and legal attributes is equivalent to stride=1 or start<limit on each transformed axis (masked axes only for reverse). Whenever legal, the complete original and replacement logical tensors agree for all input values. Unmasked axes are unchanged. Empty extents and rank zero admitted.
observations.residual: Signed mathematical attributes; native overflow, runtime extents, physical layout, graph dispatch/status and source correspondence open.

observations.name: selectContractionScaleBoundary
observations.scope: Exact Int unit-filter contraction with arbitrary finite cell list, selected left/right inputs and per-cell predicates. Universal equality for fixed factors holds iff (0,0) or (1,1).
observations.residual: Other traversals, floating-point behavior, layouts, multiple graph uses and source effects open. Configured historical counterexample is separate.

observations.name: nestedDecodedLogicalSlice
observations.scope: Arbitrary-rank consistent mathematical decoding and bounded static extents. Nested slicing equals a direct slice whose start sums the separately clamped starts.
observations.residual: The native high-bit u64 profile decodes inconsistently. Backend semantics, layout, mutation, status and physical representation remain open.

gatherBound.notes: The representability direction is inherited; necessity at every larger extent after wraparounds is new. Two proof failures repaired, review harness axiom allowlist corrected and replayed.
